policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

review.text: Aidan Smith has made thirty-seven saves for William Jewell and conceded six, a save percentage of .860.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Southwest Baptist's thirty-one goals are more than Lewis, Upper Iowa and William Jewell have scored between them, and they have conceded twenty-two doing it; the goals have not bought a place near the top of the table.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Lincoln are the last side in the conference without a defeat, and they got there by beating Southwest Baptist.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Lincoln remain the only programme in the conference yet to lose: five wins and three draws, sixteen goals scored and six conceded, the latest win coming at home to William Jewell on Wednesday.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Missouri S&T have still not drawn a match this season: seven wins and three defeats, twenty-one goals scored and eleven conceded, the seventh win coming at home to Drury on Wednesday.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Two matches past their date carry no result, and both are Drury's, one at home and one away, both from August.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Truman have scored eighteen goals and conceded twenty, and Jacob Panagos has ten of the eighteen from twenty-five shots.
